document_title: ALLEY KINGS — Complete Art & Map Design Portfolio

overview.art_style: Urban fantasy street art meets cyberpunk neon meets cartoon strategy game (Clash of Clans meets Sunflower Land meets graffiti culture)
overview.render_style: Isometric 3D for buildings, top-down for world map, side-scrolling for mini-games, card-frame close-up for tower battles

tier_1_major_world_maps.description: Large-scale overworld maps that players navigate between buildings and districts

maps.name: The Core District
maps.theme: Urban downtown core, neon-lit alleys, graffiti-covered buildings, steam vents, street vendors
maps.art_prompt: Isometric 3D urban street scene at night, neon signs in electric purple and cyan, graffiti-covered brick walls, wet asphalt reflecting lights, steam rising from manhole covers, street vendors with glowing carts, cyberpunk alleyways with hidden doorways, cartoon strategy game aesthetic like Clash of Clans but grittier, vibrant saturated colors, clean readable silhouettes for gameplay, 2000x2000 pixel tileset, 64x64 grid, game asset, transparent background for objects, Unity-ready
maps.artist_notes: This is the FIRST thing players see. Must hook in 10 seconds. Make the Main Tower visually dominant — tallest building, pulsing neon crown, visible from anywhere on the map.

maps.name: The Outskirts
maps.theme: Industrial wasteland, abandoned factories, scrap yards, underground fight clubs, black market
maps.unlock_condition: Main Tower Level 10 OR Prestige Reset 1
maps.art_prompt: Isometric 3D industrial wasteland, rusted metal structures, abandoned factories with broken windows, scrap heaps with glowing salvage, underground entrance with neon 'FIGHT PIT' sign, toxic green puddles with bubbles, chain-link fences with barbed wire, graffiti tags marking territory, cyberpunk industrial aesthetic, cartoon strategy game style, dark moody lighting with neon accents, 2500x2500 pixel tileset, 64x64 grid, game asset, transparent background for objects, Unity-ready
maps.artist_notes: Contrast with Core District — this is DANGEROUS. Use warning colors (orange, red, toxic green). Make the Fight Pit visually exciting — crowds visible, lights flashing, energy in the air.

maps.name: The Neon Abyss
maps.theme: Futuristic megacity, holographic advertisements, flying vehicles, sky bridges, elite districts
maps.unlock_condition: Prestige Reset 2 OR District vs District victory
maps.art_prompt: Isometric 3D futuristic megacity, towering skyscrapers with holographic advertisements, flying vehicles leaving light trails, glass sky bridges connecting buildings, neon-lit streets with reflective surfaces, elite district with golden accents, cyberpunk utopia aesthetic, vibrant holographic colors, clean geometric architecture mixed with chaotic street level, cartoon strategy game style but premium feel, 3000x3000 pixel tileset, 64x64 grid, game asset, transparent background for objects, Unity-ready
maps.artist_notes: This is the PRESTIGE zone. Players who reach here are ELITE. Make it feel exclusive — golden accents, holographic VIP signs, visible sky arena with crowds. Every building should look expensive.
